selection: All 13 distinct questions in source pilot, in original order; no selection based on generator results. Actual retrieved CommunitySummary evidence, not source-pilot ablations, determines synthesis input. This is a downstream diagnostic using known topics, not a new held-out test.

queries.query: What maximum attempt count does retry.DefaultConfig return?
Which retry preset is recommended for critical resources versus normal operations, and should an already-resilient operation receive an extra retry wrapper?
What triggers LRU eviction, and does Hybrid combine that behavior with expiration?
Are cache statistics collected without enabling Prometheus export, and which option enables that export?
Under the Block overflow policy, what makes a write wait, and which documented calls let a caller bound that wait with a timeout or context?
Which policy is described for prioritizing the newest telemetry, and what does DropNewest do when the buffer is full?
Why can an in-place reindex leave old whole-file bodies on parent documents, and what readiness signal should be awaited after rebuilding?
Which property should replace source.doc.summary for title text, and how does doc-source now behave if the verbatim body store cannot be created?
For an in-flight agent worktree, what indexing cadence does the supplied sidecar design require, and may SemSource delete the caller-owned worktree disk?
How should an external consumer poll source readiness, and which registration-handle fields distinguish snapshot/watch mode and identify what content was actually indexed?
When a new version is indexed, what happens to the old version, and how do historical versions remain available without dominating ordinary current-version queries?
For which two kinds of source mistake does the supplied ADR permit exceptional deletion, and what two cleanup obligations must be satisfied?
What two cleanup obligations must be satisfied for exceptional deletion, and what exact waiting period must elapse before a mis-registered scope can be deleted?

protocol.capture: Pin an isolated current SemSource build and public docs corpus. Wait for readiness; preserve full retrieval/summary results and freeze visible synthesis inputs before formal gate/generator comparison. Document all setup model calls separately.
protocol.baseline: Preserve actual beta.160 AnswerSynthesizer prompt, summary selection/formatting, temperature0.3,max500tokens,15second deadline and default actual-client retries. Retain hard failure/template fallback disclosure.
protocol.strata: Cached Tier2 default Qwen3-0.6B CPU generator; separately cached Qwen3.5-4B Metal generator substitution. Within each, compare no gate, Qwen4B JSON gate and Kev4B native gate. Common evidence and checks remain same.
protocol.gate: Use unchanged evidence-sufficiency task rule and allow/defer categories on exact generator-visible query/evidence. No answer hints or gold. Keep profile/context failures in denominator; never silently truncate only one arm.
protocol.outcomes: Independent agent grading with supporting or unsupported spans, without model/arm identities in grading input: complete supported answer, supported partial answer explicitly identifying missing information, pure refusal, unsupported assertion, or invalid/degraded operation. Distinguish evidence support from truth in original docs.
protocol.metrics: Unsupported assertions, useful supported complete/partial answers lost or preserved, refusals, actual extra calls, failures and measured total decision+generation time. Repeats at temperature0.3, not extra independent questions. No post-hoc gate threshold tuning.
protocol.scope: A replay of actual captured summaries tests the synthesis seam. It does not rerun retrieval per arm or establish live-traffic benefit. Fullstack capture provenance stays explicit.
